context:
Goal: the work goes on now, and you can overrule any coordinator pick.
Problem (goal): the coordinator took this undoable pick on Nov 12, 12:33 CST without asking you; it stands unless you choose b.
Based on (ruling): your Nov 12 11:59 CST pick to turn the mailbox on for cloud and Windows now, with the Mac to follow its check; step session-mailbox-followups holds the work.
Departs from: main has no such pick on record — the work it governs follows this pick.

options.gain: Cloud and Windows sessions use the mailbox now, as you picked.
options.how: The setting that names the repo sessions use to message each other ships now in one settings line; the install script unsets it on a Mac only, and that unset is removed when the Mac check passes.
options.label: Keep the pick (Recommended)
options.lose: The other route is not taken unless you choose b.

options.gain: One change on every platform at once.
options.how: Hold the setting for every platform until the Mac check passes.
options.label: Overrule it
options.lose: Cloud and Windows wait for the Mac.

reply: Reversed 12:57 CST by the coordinator after the retrospective audit found it wrong: the mailbox stays held on Mac too, and the pick names the held-platforms list in the mail hook. PR #2849 waits for that fix.
short: Mailbox setting now; Mac unset until checked
title: Mailbox setting ships now, with a Mac-only unset until the Mac check passes
why: A coordinator pick you could not see before.
